description: This file defines the 'TemplateRenderException' class within the 'OrangeHRM\Core\Mail' namespace. It extends the base PHP Exception class to represent exceptions specific to template rendering errors in the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system.

classes.name: TemplateRenderException
classes.description: A custom exception class used to indicate errors specifically related to template rendering within the OrangeHRM mail system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a new TemplateRenderException with an optional message, error code, and previous throwable; it delegates to the parent Exception constructor.
